title: Unit manifest v1
description: units/<id>/unit.json (D-067, plan v3 §4.2): the one place that says what a unit is, who owns it and which files are its own. The size budget is not here: it is the registry entries units.size_target, units.size_ceiling and units.context_budget; a manifest holds only an override, and an override cites a decision. Since U2 a manifest also holds the architecture rules of the unit and the ring it sits in. scripts/lib/units.py validates every manifest against this schema and the rules it cannot state (the id equals the directory, the owner is registered, the cited decision exists).

id.description: The unit id; equals the directory name units/<id>/ and the stable address @ou/<id> (P-03).

purpose.description: What the unit does, in one sentence.

cell.description: The group of units of one of today's contexts (plan v3 §4); at 100x each cell gets its own train.

owner.description: The lane that exclusively owns the unit (D-065 (4), D-069 item 8); one of units.owners. A change outside the lane's units needs this owner's approval. Forge-agnostic: a forge identity is derived from it, never written here.

paths.description: The unit's files as of today, repository-relative globs (* inside one segment, ** any segments, every other character literal). Every production file matches exactly one unit (scripts/lib/unit_check.py).

shared.description: Paths of `paths` that other lanes also write (generated data, a shared config): a shared path stays owned (its owner still approves a change that touches no other unit of its lane, train_ownership.refusals) but never decides the lane of a change on its own (train_ownership.lanes, LANE-OWN). Each entry is also listed in `paths` (scripts/lib/units.py).

requires.description: Allowed dependencies: unit id to the contract version range it may import (plan v3 §4.2 item 5). U0 seeds it from the measured import graph; U2 enforces it.

ring.description: The ring every production file of the unit sits in, when it holds one ring (ADR-36, D-058): kernel, or a context ring (domain, ports, application, server, client, testing). The checker refuses a production file outside it (L8.unit-ring). Absent: the unit spans rings, or holds no context code.

entry.description: The file that exports the unit's published surface, relative to the unit's home.

version.description: The contract's semantic version; a breaking change goes expand->contract (P-07, D-029).

contract.description: Contract slot (plan v3 §4.2 item 3); filled when the unit migrates (U3a, U4).

command.description: The unit battery's command; filled by U3a (scripts/unit-battery <id>).

battery.description: Battery slot (plan v3 §4.2 item 6). Its time budget is the registry entry battery.unit_time_limit, never a literal here.

budget.description: Overrides of the registry size budget only, keyed by the registry name they replace for this unit; each cites the decision that allows it. Absent, the registry value applies.

intents.description: Intent ids the unit serves (plan v3 §4.2 item 2).

decisions.description: Decisions the unit carries out (D-NNN of docs/domain/DECISIONS.md).

invariants.description: Invariants of docs/domain/CONTRACT.md the unit guards.

rules.description: The architecture rules this unit guards, as data (plan v3.1 U2, D-067): scripts/check-architecture.mjs compiles every manifest's entries with scripts/lib/architecture/engine.mjs. Entries sharing an id form one rule, in manifest order.

path.description: A repository-relative glob; no leading slash, no trailing slash, no negation.

range.description: A caret range of a contract version.

decision.description: The decision that allows this unit its own budget; an override without one is refused.

regex.description: A JavaScript regular expression; {src}, {web} and {contexts} expand to the source root, the web root and the context names; in a condition, {from:N} is group N of the file filter's match.

match.description: The file matches one of these; the first that matches gives the groups {from:N}.

not.description: The file matches none of these.

prod.description: Only production files (not a test, a testing ring or a test route; architecture.test_file, architecture.non_production).

exemptWithoutSql.description: A file matching one of these is exempt while it holds no SQL literal (an intents registry naming its tables as data, D-060).

imports.description: text: the file imports a specifier matching one of these (an edge of the source tree).

resolved.description: true: the specifier resolves to a repository path; false: a package or Node import.

specifierSuffix.description: Appended to the specifier before `specifier` is tested (a closing quote).

target.description: The resolved path matches; an unresolved edge never does.

names.description: Tested on the resolved path and the specifier, joined by a space.

targetFile.description: The resolved path is a file of the source tree.

targetCatalog.description: The resolved path is a literal catalog (D-063).

line.description: The importing line matches (a type-only import).

notLine.description: The importing line does not match.

condition.description: A condition on one import edge: every key it names holds.

id.description: The rule id; entries sharing it form one rule.

since.description: The architecture state the rule applies from (architecture.layer_order); absent, architecture.default_layer.

why.description: The decision or invariant the entry carries out, in one sentence.

edges.description: The edge sets judged, in order: the source tree's imports, the tooling's (architecture.tooling_root); absent, src.

fileText.description: The importing file's text matches one of these.

forbid.description: The edge breaks the rule when one of these holds; absent, every edge of the filter does.

allow.description: An edge for which one of these holds never breaks the rule.

detail.description: The violation's detail; {specifier} and {target} expand to the edge's.

id.description: The rule id; entries sharing it form one rule.

since.description: The architecture state the rule applies from (architecture.layer_order); absent, architecture.default_layer.

why.description: The decision or invariant the entry carries out, in one sentence.

scope.description: The files read: the source tree, the tooling tree, the named `paths`; absent, files.

paths.description: Repository paths read when scope names paths; {src} and {web} expand.

comments.description: keep the text, blank the comments in place (lines kept), or strip them (report at line 1).

when.description: The text matches every one of these.

unless.description: The text matches none of these.

patterns.description: What breaks the rule; absent, a file that passes when and unless does.

flags.description: Extra flags of every expression of the entry.

report.description: each: every match at its line; first: the first pattern that matches, at its first match; once: line 1 when any matches. Absent, each.

exempt.description: A match in a matching file whose group 1 matches capture is not a violation.

detail.description: The violation's detail; {specifier} and {target} expand to the edge's.

id.description: The rule id; entries sharing it form one rule.

since.description: The architecture state the rule applies from (architecture.layer_order); absent, architecture.default_layer.

why.description: The decision or invariant the entry carries out, in one sentence.

scope.description: The files read: the source tree, the tooling tree, the named `paths`; absent, files.

paths.description: Repository paths read when scope names paths; {src} and {web} expand.

at.description: Report once, at this path, when any file matches; absent, each matching file.

detail.description: The violation's detail; {specifier} and {target} expand to the edge's.

id.description: The rule id; entries sharing it form one rule.

since.description: The architecture state the rule applies from (architecture.layer_order); absent, architecture.default_layer.

why.description: The decision or invariant the entry carries out, in one sentence.

edges.description: The edge sets judged, in order: the source tree's imports, the tooling's (architecture.tooling_root); absent, src.

from.description: files: the source tree; importers: every file the edge sets import from.

detail.description: The violation's detail; {specifier} and {target} expand to the edge's.

id.description: The rule id; entries sharing it form one rule.

since.description: The architecture state the rule applies from (architecture.layer_order); absent, architecture.default_layer.

why.description: The decision or invariant the entry carries out, in one sentence.

handler.description: A handler of scripts/lib/architecture/handlers.mjs, for what data alone cannot state.

params.description: The handler's paths, expressions and messages; it holds no other literal.

rule.description: One architecture rule entry (plan v3.1 U2).
